title: THREE LANDMARK PATROLS
why: His g-46 answer: Yes, a few patrols. Watch: patrols must read as a pattern you can learn and time; watch for a patroller hugging a wall on one leg.
now: Three ordinary outdoor machines walk four fixed stops, wait two seconds, and resume at the nearest stop after combat.
